question: Which player among the following won individual silver medal in the women’s 10 m air pistol event in International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Esha Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ISSF World Cup is an international shooting sport competition organized by the **International Shooting Sport Federation** (ISSF)
 
• The first ISSF World Cup was held in **1986** to promote shooting sports globally.
 
• The ISSF World Cup includes disciplines like **10m air rifle**, **10m air pistol**, trap, and skeet.
 
• The ISSF World Cup is a major qualification event for the **Olympic Games**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manu Bhaker**:

 
 
• **Young Achiever**: Manu Bhaker won the gold medal at the 2018** ISSF** World Cup at the age of 16 in the 10m Air Pistol event.
 
• **Olympic Glory:** Manu Bhaker won** two** bronze medals at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
 
• She secured one bronze in the **10m air** pistol individual event and another in the **mixed** team event.
 
• In the **25m** pistol event, she narrowly missed a medal, finishing in fourth place.
 
 
 
• **Shreya Aggarwal:**
 
 
• She won gold at the **ISSF Junior World Cup** and has been part of the national shooting team.
 
 
 
• **Rajshree Sanchet:**
 
 
• Rajshree Sancheti won the gold medal in the Women's **10m** Air Rifle category at the** 64th National Shooting Championship** in Bhopal.
